notes.title: January Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 

Hope you all had a lovely Christmas and are kicking 2018 off right. It's been a year since we had Miner Meltdown's first online alpha, and it's crazy to think how far the game has come since then.

A few things to announce:

On Feb 1, the initial "Potato Skin" launch skin will be making a temporary comeback! Play anytime in Feb to unlock this limited edition skin.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/7ee805c4482a12d58573125c3f396eb00f00fa80.png

Miner Meltdown's soundtrack produced by Bob Baffy is now available on our Steam page. Check it out! It's pretty darn catchy.

I've been working on a new game-mode! It's taking a bit longer than expected, but I'll hopefully have some details on that soon so sit tight! I may need some testers so be sure to join our Discord community.

Also, We're 5 reviews short of hitting that magic 50 number. Reviews good or constructive are always appreciated!

Cheers!!
- James

notes.title: Progress Update since leaving Early Access + 1.1.0.6
notes.notes:
Lots of updates since Miner Meltdown transitioned out of Early Access in August!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/a02d680d8bcd09423ff2fbb464115756dfddc344.gif
 
1.1.0.1
Trading cards added!
- Collect packs to earn some pretty cool badges, emoticons, and custom backgrounds. 
- There's also a new hot fix live that updated the default secondary weapon to work with left-control on the keyboard

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/3013b01453f638d48ae12af8cf8e9b78cac9311e.png

1.1.0.2
- Improved initial load time

..1.1.0.4:
- Mini-map upgrades: You can now see your teammates, chests that you've found, and merchants on the mini-map.
- You can also ping areas of the mini-map to alert your teammates.
- Also added an optional inverted controls toggle in the settings (it was requested so that up/down while roping can be reversed).
- Fixed a long standing bug where clicking the mini-map stops your weapon from firing!
- Leaderboards have been reset for the month! Hop in the top 10 early to grab that sexy leaberboard skin.

1.1.0.5:
fixed a rare but annoying bug where sometimes the server thinks your on the opposing team, and you cannot damage the enemy team or score points.

Hotfix 1.1.0.6 - Settings bug fix

Just put up a patch for a fix for a settings bug. If you changed your monitor after adjusting the settings, it could prevent you from loading up settings again.
Should be fixed up now!

notes.title: 1 Month Until Full Release!
notes.notes:
1 Month Away From Full Release!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/f7d7357040b7b6f92bf825c813628805bb5b3c6e.gif

So, Miner Meltdown is officially 1 month away from its transition from Early Access to Full Release!
 
Many have asked me what is the difference of being in Early Access vs Full Release: When Miner Meltdown hit Early Access, it had 1 game-mode, no bots, no unlockable items, and it wasn’t overly hard to find a fair share of bugs. It was playable, but definitely not a complete game. The game is now very close to being the game that I envisioned making, and this next update will mark a big milestone.
 
I’m aligning the game’s biggest update yet with its full release: New weapons, brand new gametype, and more surprises!
I’ll share more details on the new features as we get closer to the date!

Stay tuned!
– James
And P.S, If you haven’t already picked up the game, it’s still 40% for the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: Miner Meltdown Summer Kickoff Update (1.0.3.4) + 40% off!!!
notes.notes:
The Steam Summer Sale is here! Which means you can grab a copy of Miner Meltdown for 40% off!

1.0.3.4 Gameplay

To celebrate, We've packed a pile of new features into today's update. See the full patch notes below!

 Features 

    Molotov Cocktail weapon added.
    Cluster Grenade weapon added.
    Monthly Leaderboards.
    "Leaderboard Miner" skin unlock for the top 10 monthly players.
    Limited Edition "Beach Miner" skin for anyone who plays the game
 during the Steam Summer Sale.


 Fixes 

    Leaderboards show your rank and your friends rank even if outside the top 10.
    Fix for secondary weapons occasionally get stuck in your hand.
    Fix for your player's name is hidden behind "Boogy Miner's afro".
    Fix for occasional invisible players.
    Workaround for 4:3 resolutons can't access gadgets in shop.

notes.title: Teleporter update live! (1.0.3.1)
notes.notes:
Hey all. 1.0.3.1 is officially live!
The sexy portion of this update is the snazzy new teleporter weapon, but it's also packed with a big pile of bug fixes and stability improvements. 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/1b32afbcb004987f8e9031e840f918facad4740b.gif

Full patch notes below:

 Major Updates 

 Teleporter added
 Weapon unlocks based on level
 Bullet shell particle effects added
 Player / gut-buster explosion effects beefed up



 Bug fixes 

 Fixed infinite rope-jumping exploit.
 Fixed occasional black screen on load.
 Fixed occasional friendly fire issues
 Gold / diamonds less laggy, no longer float in mid-air
 Fixed issues caused when 2 new users join a match in progress simultaneously
 Bots no longer flicker when directly above target
 Fixed cart noise sometimes doesn't work
 Fixed diamond dash drop-off occasionally missing
 Fixed can't drop the drill with the e button.
 Much less likely to fall through the map.
 Number keys working after respawning
 Teammate colors fixed in the chat
 Lowered screen-shake radius
 Progress Bar no longer goes past the end on max-level


 Balancing Changes 

  Bots accuracy and reaction time improved
  Flamethrower damage increased
  Lightning Gun damage increased
  Bots can use Blaster


Thanks for reading! Don't forget to join the Discord to let me know what you want to see added to the game.

notes.title: Miner Meltdown Easter Update (1.0.2.0) is here!
notes.notes:
The Miner Meltdown Easter Update (1.0.2.0) is upon us!
Which means that you get new weapons, a new game-type, a limited edition skin, and more!

New Weapons
You voted, and the newest weapons joining the arsenal are the medic gun, and the alien blaster. Go try em' out.  
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/fa8242b7327d941414488ecac181e5ea3b2af091.png     http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/a18a63913139a27698f5507cb0f35295efa982a4.png    

New Game Type!
Miner Meltdown has a brand new game-type: Diamond Dash.
- Collect diamonds and bring them to the central drop-off zone to score points. But be careful, if you get killed, your enemies will pick up all of the diamonds that you dropped.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/e7271d7cb74bd72354a41257ff9afbf2bc84730f.png

Limited Edition Easter Skin!
Play anytime before Easter, and you'll have a chance at unlocking the limited edition Bunny Miner.http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/9a81e768505098b962aa4ff45a7c817be5c8e01d.png

"Kill The Dev" Achievement Added!
If you see this guy hopping in/out of your games, then that would be me. Manage to blow me up and you'll unlock a special achievement.
I will be streaming Monday (April 10) at 7-9pm (EST) if you're looking to find me! https://www.twitch.tv/mighty_pebble
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26549816/6e740f029abda2057e5f01c7487d5ac4a7e50c83.png

Full Patch Notes

Added medic gun and alien blaster
Added Diamond Dash game-type
Added limited seasonal bunny skin
Added achievement for killing the dev, and a custom dev skin
Instructions animate at the start of a match
Toned down fall damage
Reduced chance of over-powered chest drops
Bot improvements to avoid fall damage, and chase loose minerals
Fixed bug where bots are too powerful with lighting gun
Fixed bug where your character keeps moving after clicking out/in window
Fixed glow-sticks not always lightning up bug
Improved joining in progress occasional issues


Don't forget to  join the Discord community to give your feedback on which weapons, game-types, features, or anything at all that you'd like to see added next

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE/ DEVELOPMENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 

So! I’m excited to officially announce the Early Access release date for Miner Meltdown… which is… **Drum Roll**
 
  Thursday, February 23, 2017!!! 

Thats right! Less than one month until the game is publicly available through the Steam Store!

There’s been a ton of people asking about another beta before the launch date, so on Saturday, February 4th, the servers will be back online for a one-day play-test (time TBD). Any keys/activations from the previous beta will still work and a new batch of beta keys will be sent to a select number of new sign-up’ees before the beta date. You can still sign up over  here

Thanks for reading! It’s been a crazy journey so far, and I’m mega excited to get the game in your hands soon!

James
